minutes.headline: Planning Board approved a three-lot ANR, two committee appointments and two scenic road requests; garage hearing continued.
minutes.summary: The board approved an ANR dividing the former Stone Farm package store lot into three, accepted a resignation and made two appointments to the Economic Development Committee. It continued the PSG Realty garage site plan hearing and the 780 Northfield Road scenic road hearing (site walk set), and approved 1255 Lancaster Ave and Unitil's reliability tree removals. It also discussed warrant articles on the marijuana bylaw and water supply protection district, and Pond View.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved an ANR dividing the lot at 790-792 Mass Ave into three, 3-0 by roll call.
It continued the 225/259 Leominster Shirley Road garage site plan and stormwater hearing to March 28, 4-0.
The 780 Northfield Road scenic road hearing was continued to March 28, with a site visit set for March 21 at 5 pm.
The board approved scenic road work at 1255 Lancaster Ave and Unitil's reliability tree removals, with the wood removed from site, both 4-0.
It accepted one Economic Development Committee resignation and made two appointments, all 3-0.

why_it_matters: The three-lot ANR means new building lots, which would need sewer stubs and betterment or privilege fees, a cost that falls on the owners of those lots.
The garage site plan and the Northfield Road scenic road work are still undecided, so neighbors can still weigh in at the March 28 hearings.
The board is preparing marijuana bylaw and water supply protection district articles that residents may be asked to vote on at town meeting.
watch_next: March 28 at 6:05 pm: continued hearings for 225/259 Leominster Shirley Road and 780 Northfield Road, after the March 21 site visit.
A public hearing tentatively set for April 11 on the marijuana bylaw clarification article.

reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on every approval vote and on the hearing continuations. Names are misheard in ours, and several decisions and attendees appear in only one record. The main difference is that ours records votes to close the 1255 Lancaster Ave and Unitil hearings, which the official minutes do not record, and the official minutes say decisions on both hearings would be prepared for the next meeting.
